title: GitHub as the External Brain for Naya Power Continuity

source.path: Naya Power Smart Notes and Restore Context design

summary: Naya Power treats its canonical GitHub repository as an organized external brain: durable knowledge is structured, timestamped, indexed, related, retrievable, and used to restore relevant context across sessions.
what_happened: The memory problem was reframed from trying to make an AI remember everything internally to building an external, machine-readable knowledge system that a new session can deliberately restore.
what_we_learned: Memory and intelligence are complementary but distinct.
A useful external brain needs organization, recall, relationships, authority, time, and conflict handling.
The system should retrieve concepts even when exact terminology is forgotten.
History must remain available so changed decisions can be understood in temporal context.
why_it_matters: This converts context loss from a recurring conversational failure into an engineering problem with a repository-backed recovery procedure.
what_changed: NayaPOWER became the canonical repository for the runtime brain and memory layer.
Restore Context became an explicit operational command.
next_best_action: Continuously ingest high-value durable knowledge as Smart Notes and validate the memory index in CI.
evidence: Explicit architecture decision recorded in 2026-08-23 design session
